memory_candidates.content: GKWZ 2003 (Many-Dimensional Modal Logics) is indexed as an OCR-damaged extract with no PDF in its sources/ directory, but the global metadata.json names the staging PDF at ~/Documents/literature-staging/gabbay_2003/. `pdftotext -layout` on it reproduces theorem statements cleanly: Thm 5.27 (2-exponential abstract fmp for L x S5), Thm 5.28 (coN2EXPTIME, printed p. 244), Thm 5.32 (no product fmp for LogC x L with an ascending omega-type chain in C, printed p. 246), and the 'repeating finite pieces' passage on pp. 234/236. Proof formulas remain garbled; cite statements and figure captions only.

Failure of a finite model property for a frame class does not imply undecidability, and the distinction that matters is WHICH class: K4 x S5 lacks the product fmp (GKWZ 5.32) but has the 2-exponential abstract fmp (5.27), hence coN2EXPTIME (5.28) and EXPSPACE-complete (Krommes 2020 Thm 1.1). When validity is tied to one frame class with no abstract relaxation (as PlusValidZTime is to regular Z-frames), the published remedy is GKWZ's 'infinite models constructed from repeating finite pieces' -- the HWZ 2000 quasimodel: finite state candidates per time point, runs through them, splice lemma, ultimately periodic state function.

A logic-domain context note for this repository is authored in the formal extension's source store (~/.config/nvim/agent-system/extensions/formal/context/project/logic/domain/), registered with one entry in that extension's index-entries.json (shape: path, summary, category 'domain', line_count, load_when.agents [logic-research-agent, formal-research-agent], load_when.task_types [logic, formal], domain 'project', subdomain 'logic', topics) and one README 'Domain Files' line, then redeployed with deploy-headless.sh. Writing under .claude/context/ directly is wiped at the next deploy. The note must not contain 'task N' phrasing, but specs/<NNN>_slug/ paths are permitted by the lint pattern.
